svg.title: About Nitin
svg.text: Hey, I'm Nitin, an M.Tech student in Data Science at SRM University AP, based in Dehradun. I
build data pipelines, REST APIs and machine learning models, and I care about work that
keeps running after the demo is over.
I turn raw data into things teams can use. 50+ GB of geospatial data at Evigway, 10+ REST
endpoints at IBM, reporting over 100k+ records and 20+ KPIs at NameKart.
+12% validation IoU. -20% release turnaround. -40% manual reporting. 200k+ product reviews
ProjectFlow, a project management backend with 20+ REST endpoints. Amazon reviews sentiment
